slug: 2025-11-06 Morocco prepares 'Digital X.o' draft law (AI governance, sectoral digital IDs, interoperability)

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Morocco's 'Digital X.o' draft law, covering AI governance, data interoperability and digital identity, was still being worked on before submission to parliament, and that the Minister Delegate for Digital Transition said it clarifies data interoperability among government institutions (a draft bill, not in force); no event date is given, so the article's published date is used.
